items.e: Disciple [make disciples of] all the nations, baptizing them
items.o: Μαθητεύσατε πάντα τὰ ἔθνη, βαπτίζοντες αὐτοὺς

items.e: into the Name of the Father,
teaching them to observe all things whatsoever I have commanded you.
items.o: διδάσκοντες αὐτοὺς τηρεῖν πάντα ὅσα ἐνετειλάμην ὑμῖν.

items.e: Note.—For an explanation of the Baptismal Formula, which is the basis of the old Trinitarian creeds, and for the various renderings of εἰς (into, to, in, with reference to), see Schaff and Lange, Com. on Matt. pp. 556–558.
